Hi Ellie — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and suggested next steps so we keep momentum on procurement routing.

Call highlights (30m):
- Primary objective: pilot Redwood inference for clinical-notes summarization (internal PHI-safe test data).
- Top constraint: must route purchases via existing AWS Marketplace contract if possible; otherwise PO flow is acceptable but needs vendor setup with AP.
- Security asks: SOC2 report + data residency statement (US).
- Timeline: procurement kick-off this week, pilot contract signed by end of month if paperwork moves.

Open questions for procurement:
1) Are you able to accept AWS Marketplace Private Offer (PO/contract through marketplace) or do you require a direct vendor PO/invoice process?
2) Who is the procurement contact (name/email) that handles vendor onboarding and tax/Vendor forms?
3) Any internal PO number format / mandated billing terms (net30/net45)?

Proposed next steps:
- I’ll send a brief marketplace + PO comparison doc and the marketplace eligibility questionnaire for you to share with procurement (attached).
- Ben will follow up on billing/PO options and provide sample invoice flow for both Marketplace Private Offer and direct invoice.
- Can you introduce procurement contact on this thread?

Attachments: NovaMed_Marketplace_Questionnaire.pdf (questionnaire), short checklist.

Thanks — Sofia

Hi Ellie / Priya — thanks for jumping in. Quick note on the two common commercial paths and what each would mean operationally for NovaMed:

1) AWS Marketplace Private Offer
   - Benefits: purchase via existing Marketplace contract, consolidated billing, simplified vendor onboarding for your AP team.
   - Redwood actions: create Private Offer and provide Seller Offer ID; Redwood will accept PO via marketplace and route invoices through AWS.
   - Time to enable: typically 3–7 business days once procurement confirms PO intent and we have a signed PO/commit.

2) Direct vendor PO / invoice (paper flow)
   - Benefits: traditional for customers without marketplace contracts.
   - Redwood actions: provide W-9, SOC2 report, vendor onboarding packet; Redwood sends monthly invoice per PO.
   - Time to enable: depends on your vendor onboarding cadence (often 7–21 days).

Action items I’m taking now: attached is a short CSV with PO onboarding fields we commonly need (PO_instructions_AWS.csv) and the marketplace checklist Sofia sent. I’ll also share a sample Private Offer flow with the exact line-item breakdown for the pilot.

Priya — can you confirm if NovaMed needs a vendor form/portal entry (SAP Ariba, Coupa, manual PDF)? If yes, we’ll fill and return immediately. Also let us know the person who signs POs.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0123

Thanks — looking forward to your confirmation.
